experiment: Diagnostic back-check of the frozen accounting candidate on the earlier 677-condition design set
purpose: Determine whether the 5% TTFT reserve actually catches the previously observed high-load unsafe approvals, while measuring the effect of remaining-Prefill blocking on conservative rejections.
evidence_role: diagnostic only; these 677 conditions were already used for mechanism diagnosis and are not held-out confirmation

comparison.label: remaining blocking plus global 5% TTFT reserve

amendment: After the first back-check showed that the global 5% TTFT reserve cut only one unsafe approval while greatly increasing conservative rejections, add the remaining-blocking-only condition to isolate the two mechanisms. This is diagnostic on the already-used design set, not held-out evidence.
